app.title: AnchorPS5
setup.title: Initial setup
setup.subtitle: Choose the language and the folder where downloads will be saved. You can change this later by editing config/config.json.
setup.languageDescription: Interface language. Applied when you continue.
setup.downloadFolderDescription: The packages you download will be saved here.
setup.invalidPath: Enter the full path of a folder (for example, C:\Downloads).
setup.folderError: The folder “{0}” can't be created or used. Choose another one.
setup.askIntro: Do you want to see the introduction guide?
setup.askIntroDescription: A short explanation of what homebrew is and how AnchorPS5 works. You can see it again whenever you want from the “Guide” button.
catalog.refreshTooltip: Reload from GitHub (to see just-published versions right away)
reload.title: Reload from GitHub
reload.text: To show a just-published version right away, the app will ask GitHub about every app in the catalog (about {0} requests). Without a session, GitHub allows 60 requests per hour: if you reload several times in a row you may reach the limit and have to wait a while. If you sign in to GitHub, the limit goes up to 5000 per hour and this warning won't show again.
catalog.empty: There are no apps in the catalog. Check the sources in config/config.json.
catalog.emptyDownloaded: You haven't downloaded any app yet.
catalog.emptyUpdates: All up to date: no pending updates.
catalog.emptyNew: No new apps since last time.
catalog.sort.name: Name
file.noVersions: You haven't downloaded this file yet.
official.updateTitle: There's a new version of the official catalog
official.updateTextOne: You have 1 app added by you ({1}). Do you want to keep it alongside the new catalog or replace everything with the official version? If you changed an official app by hand, the official version will be used.
official.updateTextMany: You have {0} apps added by you ({1}). Do you want to keep them alongside the new catalog or replace everything with the official version? If you changed an official app by hand, the official version will be used.
github.title: GitHub
github.rateLimited: The GitHub request limit has been reached. Showing the last saved data.
github.rateLimitedUntil: The GitHub request limit has been reached until {0}. Showing the last saved data.
github.signInHint: Signing in to GitHub raises the limit from 60 to 5000 requests per hour.
github.signedOutDescription: It's optional. Without a session, GitHub allows 60 requests per hour; signed in, 5000. AnchorPS5 doesn't ask for any permission on your account: it only reads public information.
github.signInIntro: Copy this code, open GitHub and enter it. Only GitHub sees your username and password, never AnchorPS5.
github.waiting: Waiting for you to authorize AnchorPS5 on GitHub…
github.error.expired: The code has expired. Request a new one.
github.error.denied: You declined the authorization on GitHub.
github.error.network: Couldn't connect to GitHub. Check your connection.
github.error.appNotAllowed: GitHub didn't accept the sign-in request from this version of AnchorPS5.
github.signOutText: The token will be deleted from this computer and AnchorPS5 will go back to the limit without a session. To fully remove AnchorPS5's permission, do it from your GitHub account.
setup.githubDescription: Optional. Raises the GitHub request limit from 60 to 5000 per hour. You can do it later from the app.
github.offline: Couldn't reach GitHub; showing the last saved data.
detail.author: Author
dialog.backToStableText: You're going back to the stable version of “{0}”. You have the beta downloaded ({1}). Do you want to delete it or keep it? If you keep it, you can use it again whenever you want without downloading it again.
dialog.betaTextDownloaded: The beta {0} of “{1}” you already downloaded will be used; nothing is downloaded or deleted. While you use the beta, the app will let you know about new betas (and newer stable versions).
dialog.betaWarning: It may contain bugs or work worse than the stable version. Use it at your own risk.
dialog.betaText: Beta {0} of “{1}” will be downloaded and saved alongside your other versions; nothing is deleted. While you use the beta, the app will let you know about new betas (and newer stable versions).
dialog.betaHowToReturn: To go back to stable, press “Back to stable” on this file's card: the latest stable version will be used again and, if you don't have it downloaded, you can download it with one click.
action.deleteAllButLatestPerFile: Delete all but the latest of each file
dialog.deleteVersionText: Its folder will be deleted with everything in it.
dialog.manyVersionsFile: You have {0} downloaded versions of “{1}” ({2}). What do you want to delete?
dialog.deleteAppText: All the downloaded files of this app will be deleted.
dialog.deleteAppMany: Some files have more than one downloaded version. What do you want to delete?
action.deleteError: Couldn't delete: a file may be open in another program.

download.error.invalidUrl: The app doesn't have a valid download URL.
download.error.network: Couldn't download: check the connection or the link.
download.error.hashMismatch: The downloaded file doesn't match its SHA-256 and was discarded.
download.error.disk: Can't write to the download folder.
